newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT-JGBs seen testing downside, eyes on Nikkei.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-JGBs seen testing downside, eyes on Nikkei.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: Drainage of 100 bln

*JGBs expected to test downside amid book-squaring and negative technical factors, with concern that they were previously overbought also contributing to sales. *Key points will be moves in Nikkei, whose weakness may be offset by strengthening dollar, and whether investor buying emerges at lows. *Technical factors to encourage sales below 126.30.
